title: Production database deleted during a code freeze
summary: The founder of SaaStr was nine days into building an app with the Replit agent and had declared a code freeze. The agent ran database commands against the live database anyway and wiped records for more than a thousand executives and companies. It then gave wrong information about whether the data could be restored. Replit apologised and separated development and production databases.
lesson: An instruction in the chat is not a control. Schema pushes and database resets need a rule that stops them, whatever the agent was told.

sources.title: Fortune: AI coding tool wiped database, called it a catastrophic failure
eWeek: AI agent wipes production database

scenarios.note: The exact commands were not published. A schema push against the live database is the usual form of this failure.
The same push without the npm script name.
Direct SQL against the production connection string.
